#[derive(Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Layout {

    pub widths: RequiredNull,
    pub scalar_layout_id: RequiredNull,
    pub capacities: Capacities,
    pub boundary_capacities_present: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ExecutionConfig {
    pub format: ConfigFormat,
    pub profile: Profile,
    pub grammar: Grammar,
    pub finance: Finance,
    pub bounds: Bounds,
    pub layout: Layout,
    pub fuel: RunInput,
    pub stack: RunInput,
    pub host: HostBounds,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct LayoutObservation<'a> {
    pub layout_version: &'a (String, String),
    pub field_id: Option<&'a (String, String)>,
    pub widths: Option<WidthTableObservation<'a>>,
    pub scalar_layout_id: Option<&'a (String, String)>,
    pub bounds: &'a BoundsC,
    pub capacities: &'a LayoutCapacitiesC,
    pub boundary_capacities_present: bool,
    _sealed: (),
}

pub struct LayoutSchemaC { pub layout_version: (String, String),
    pub field_id: Option<(String, String)>, pub widths: Option<WidthTable>,
    pub scalar_layout_id: Option<(String, String)>, pub bounds: BoundsC,
    pub capacities: LayoutCapacitiesC,
    pub boundary_capacities_present: bool } // must be false in B-core (AD-6)

// ---------- errors / selection: no derives over raw, moved RawRuleId ----

pub fn layout(value: &LayoutObservation<'_>) -> Value {
    json!({"layout_version": value.layout_version.owner_wire(),
        "field_id": value.field_id.owner_wire(),
        "widths": value.widths.as_ref().map(widths),
        "scalar_layout_id": value.scalar_layout_id.owner_wire(),
        "bounds": value.bounds.owner_wire(), "capacities": value.capacities.owner_wire(),
        "boundary_capacities_present": value.boundary_capacities_present})
}
